summary: A light product-feature section on a near-white page (#fdfdfd): a floating white pill nav bar centred at the top (x 450–1160, y 26–91) with a blue rounded-square ToDesktop logo, "Products ⌄ / Docs / Changelog / Blog" in dark 16px type, an outlined "Log in" pill and a solid blue (#1754ff) "Sign up" pill. Below sit four equal bento cards in a 2×2 grid (each ≈494×455, radius ≈28, fill #f5f5f5, 26px gutter; columns x 298 and 819, rows y 98 and 580). Each card has an illustration in its upper half, a centred dark 18px title ("Code signing made easy", "Measure app success", "Distribution. Sorted!", "Performance. Benchmarked!"), a thin grey 1px divider ~294px wide, and three centred lines of grey 16px body copy. Every illustration is live: top-left, a 14×8 grid of grey monospace 0/1 digits fading toward the bottom flickers in brightness while a white/blue pen signs a grey squiggle signature on a small white window card beside an orange rosette badge with a checkmark; top-right, a bar chart on a gridded white panel builds up from one bar to four grey stacked bars (0–1s), then a white "MacOS | Windows | Linux" pill fades in above (~1.4s) and the second bar turns orange/blue/charcoal inside a raised white capsule (~1.5s); bottom-left, under a "builder.acme.com" download pill, a grey laptop opens from a flat closed base to show a soft greyscale dune wallpaper (~0.5–1.2s), then three white rounded app tiles (Apple, Windows, Linux penguin) pop up over it (~2.3s) and keep floating with small tilts; bottom-right, a skeuomorphic white speedometer with 11 tick marks and a blue needle and blue progress arc swings back and forth continuously over a faded browser window, while blurred monospace grey "NNMS" latency labels drift and streak around it. Nav, cards, titles and body text never move.

criteria.check: Four equal cards sit in a 2×2 grid: columns starting x≈298 and x≈819, rows starting y≈98 and y≈580, each ≈494×455 px, with a ≈26px gap
Cards are a flat light grey (#f5f5f5) on a lighter near-white page (#fdfdfd), with no border line and corner radius ≈28px
A white fully rounded nav pill spans x≈450–1160, y≈26–91, centred above the grid, with a soft wide shadow
Nav reads, left to right: logo, 'Products' with a down chevron, 'Docs', 'Changelog', 'Blog', in dark ~16px type
'Sign up' is a solid vivid blue (#1754ff) pill with white text at x≈1060–1147
'Log in' is a white pill with a thin light grey outline and dark text, left of Sign up
Logo is a ≈35px blue rounded square with a white 'b'-shaped mark, an original drawing with the same silhouette and colour
Titles read exactly 'Code signing made easy', 'Measure app success', 'Distribution. Sorted!', 'Performance. Benchmarked!' in near-black ~18px medium, centred in their cards at y≈371 and y≈854
Top-left card body reads 'Our guided process makes purchasing and using / certificates a breeze. Our secure hardware storage and / expiry notifications give you peace of mind.' in three centred lines
Bottom-right body reads 'Measure launch time, memory, and CPU usage. / Compare across versions and other industry-standard / Electron apps.'
Body copy is mid grey (~#666), clearly lighter than the near-black titles, ~16px with ~24px line spacing
Each card has a thin 1px light grey horizontal divider ≈294px wide centred between title and body (y≈408 top row, y≈890 bottom row)
The top-left card shows a grid of monospace 0 and 1 digits, 14 columns by 8 rows at ~30px pitch spanning x≈348–742, y≈147–359
Digits are mixed grey shades (some dark, many pale) and the bottom two rows fade to nearly invisible; no digits are black or coloured
Individual digits change brightness (and some flip value) between the two moments while the grid positions stay fixed
A white rounded window card (≈174×104 at x≈458, y≈171) with three grey dots top-left and a small '×' plus baseline sits in the middle of the digit grid, hiding the digits behind it
An orange rosette badge with a white-ringed checkmark and two orange ribbon tails overlaps the card's lower-left corner at x≈444–510, y≈233–318
A white/silver pen with a blue grip band lies diagonally (tip lower-left, cap upper-right) with its tip on the signature line, casting a soft grey shadow on the card
At 0s no pen and no signature are visible on the window card; by 0.5s the pen has appeared with its tip at the baseline's left
Between 0.5s and 2.5s a grey handwritten squiggle signature appears on the line, drawn left-to-right behind the moving pen tip
A white rounded panel (≈342×135 at x≈895, y≈193) with a fine light grey grid sits on a larger faint gridded backdrop in the top-right card
The chart shows exactly 4 vertical stacked bars, each ~30px wide, made of 2–3 rounded segments, standing on a common baseline at y≈308
The second bar is coloured top to bottom orange (#f6a623-ish), thin blue, then charcoal, inside a raised white rounded capsule; the other three bars stay grey
At 0s only one tall grey bar and a small pale square are present; by 1s all four grey bars have grown in
Bar 2 is plain grey at 1s and has turned orange/blue/charcoal inside its white capsule by 2.5s
A white pill above the chart reads '[apple] MacOS | [windows] Windows | [flame/penguin] Linux' with MacOS black, Windows blue, Linux orange, separated by thin grey dividers
The OS pill is absent at 1s and fully visible at 2.5s (it fades in around 1.4s)
A white pill at x≈467–624, y≈615–643 shows a sky-blue download-arrow icon and the text 'builder.acme.com' in sky blue (~#0a8ad8)
At 0.5s the laptop is only a flat closed grey base bar at y≈790; by 1.0s its lid has risen to show a screen
The open laptop screen shows a soft greyscale dune/mountain wallpaper (photo-like, no colour), framed by a light grey bezel and a thin base
Exactly 3 white rounded-square tiles (~78px) with soft drop shadows float in front of the laptop: Apple (left), Windows 4-pane (centre), Linux penguin (right), each icon black
No app tiles are visible at 1.5s; all three are visible over the laptop by 2.5s
After appearing the tiles keep drifting: between 2.75s and 3.25s each tile shifts a few px and/or tilts slightly (Apple tile visibly rotated at 2.5s)
A circular gauge ≈170px across is centred near (1066,712) in the bottom-right card, overlapping a faded white browser window
The gauge reads as a raised skeuomorphic dial: thick white outer bezel with soft shadow, a darker grey inner ring, a light grey radial face; not a flat outlined circle
The dial face carries exactly 11 short grey tick marks around its upper ~270°, a faint inner circle, a grey hub, and a faint grey ToDesktop logo below the hub
The needle is a vivid blue tapered spike from a blue hub dot, and a blue arc runs along the inner rim from the lower-left up to the needle's angle
The needle swings: it points to about 1 o'clock at 0.5s and to about 10–11 o'clock at 1s, with the blue arc shrinking to follow it
The needle points to ~9 o'clock at 2.75s and has swung up to ~12 o'clock at 3.25s
Scattered grey monospace labels in the form two digits + 'MS' (e.g. '94MS', '43MS', '89MS') appear around the gauge across the card's upper half
Latency labels are pale grey, several are blurred or horizontally smeared, and they sit behind the gauge; none are dark or coloured
The set and positions of MS labels differ between the two moments (labels drift and new ones appear), while the card itself is still
Behind the gauge sits a white window (x≈874–1258, from y≈705) with three grey dots top-left whose lower part fades into the card with no bottom edge
Nav bar, card outlines, titles, dividers and body copy do not move or change between 0.5s and 5.4s
All four illustrations animate simultaneously from 0s (not one-at-a-time on hover): pen, bars, laptop and needle all change between 0s and 1s
